rules.distance: four pillars (facts, index scores, attitudes, heritage); domain weights start equal by pillar and are calibrated so no domain exceeds 1/15 of the leave-one-out influence; per domain the mean squared difference over the indicators both countries have, divided by that domain's mean over all pairs; no imputation
rules.boundary: every member within 1.0 world SD of its persona's median on each core dimension (members observed on that dimension); personas of at least 3
rules.claims: a variable may be claimed only if every observed member lies within 1.0 world SD of the persona median (on the variable's analysis scale) and the median is at least 0.5 SD from the world median

weighting.start: equal pillars, equal domains within a pillar

domains.label: Clean government and rule of law

core.label: Governance (democracy, clean government, rule of law)

kRule: no K met the reproducibility bar; most reproducible K chosen

familyMap.method: classical multidimensional scaling of the persona distance
